note: The DAP rows (S9). U1's rows are sniff's own: the specification is their oracle, and no program runs. Each starts `sniff --dap` afresh; tools/session-dap.py explains the steps.

rows.name: dap-initialize
rows.why: the capabilities sniff declares: exactly the nine its rows hold, each of which the pinned gdb also declares

rows.name: dap-unknown-request-live
rows.why: a request sniff does not support is refused by name, and the session goes on

steps.message: sniff does not support the request stepBack

rows.name: dap-not-a-message
rows.why: a body that frames but is not a message is reported on standard error and skipped; the next request is answered

rows.name: dap-framing-broken
rows.why: a header whose length is not a number breaks the stream's framing: sniff says so and ends with exit 1

rows.name: dap-input-truncated
rows.why: the input ends inside a message: sniff says so and ends with exit 1
steps: sniff --dap: the input ended inside a message (truncated)

rows.name: dap-input-ends
rows.why: the input ends between messages: sniff ends with exit 0
